newsitem.title: GERMANY: German state NRW says June CPI up 0.2 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: German state NRW says June CPI up 0.2 pct mth/mth.

text.p: The statistics Office in the west German state of North Rhine-Westphalia said on Tuesday that the cost of living rose 0.2 percent in June from May for an annual rate of 1.9 percent.
The state in May reported a month-on-month rise of 0.4 percent for an annual rate of 1.8 percent.
Data for four west German states, including North Rhine-Westphalia, are used to calculate a preliminary figure for Germany as a whole.
Two other states, Baden-Wuerttemberg and Bavaria, have already released inflation data for June. A fourth state, Hesse, is expected to release its data on Wednesday.
